data.name: Cozy Against Humanity
data.detailed_description:
Cozy Against Humanity is a roguelike tower defense game where the coziest things imaginable turn against you. Adapt, resist, and survive the soft apocalypse.

Humanity pushed comfort too far. Warmth, calm, and safety have become overwhelming forces that work against you.

Features

  • Singleplayer gameplay focused on strategy and survival.

  • Build your fortress to survive cozy waves

  • Upgrade your towers, character, and buildings with roguelike mechanics that make every run unique.

  • Strategically place towers and walls to control incoming enemy waves.

  • Fight alongside your towers with direct player-controlled combat.
